ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.9). Interaction and view iteration. In the vanilla Work tab, left-click cycles priority 0..max and right-click now jumps from 0 to max (otherwise decrements), keeping the distinct above-4 cell and capture. Work Control draws each pawn's portrait plus name/title in the fixed column and uses Find.Selector as the selection source: rows highlight selected pawns, single click selects, shift-click toggles, double-click selects and pans and closes the tab; Recommend applies to every selected pawn and Details opens for the first selected one. The old Draw/Manual/Both mode cycle is replaced by a clear view control: View: Numeric opens the vanilla Work tab, and the vanilla Work tab gets a View: Draw return button; both use Find.MainTabsRoot. A Mod Settings checkbox "Auto recommend new colony" (default on) controls automatic recommendation; when off, new/default colonies and new pawns copy the vanilla order instead, while the Recommend button still works. Everything else is kept: flat single-line cards, filtering search, shared horizontal scroll, outer vertical scroll, pinned/scored recommendations, incapacity filtering, Details window, hooks, respawn and the vanilla above-4 priority patch. No profiles, schedules, equipment, drag palette or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
